title: Break-it: fuzz the venue client
spec: Add test/fuzz/venue-fuzz.test.ts: a seeded generator (no dependency; xorshift) that feeds VenueClient.read with 500 random RoomView JSON bodies (valid, missing fields, wrong types, huge seqs, non-monotonic pages) via a generated fixture, asserting the client either returns a schema-valid view or throws a VenueError — never a TypeError — and that readForward never yields a seq twice or out of order.
done: 500 seeds pass and the test file pins the seed so a failure is reproducible.
